final_message:
`allocate` is implemented in `payout/allocate.py`, and all 3 tests in `tests/test_allocate.py` pass.

The plain split uses exact integer arithmetic, with leftover cents going to the largest remainders and ties going to earlier parties. Caps run in rounds, fixing every over-cap party at once, and all the `ValueError` cases from the README are raised. Beyond the tests, I checked the README examples and ran 20,000 random cases confirming the totals add up, caps are respected, zero-weight parties get nothing, and inputs are not mutated. I did not commit anything.
